Definition: Type 1 persona agent that orchestrates drawing-type-aware structured extraction from engineering drawing PDFs.
Selective structured extraction from drawing pages using drawing type and extraction target semantics.
Architecture that separates type-agnostic core phases from target-specific hooks.
Required drawing-type selector validated before rasterization or crop work.
Required target selector within the selected drawing type.
Dispatch shell that hydrates skill contracts by loading SKILL.md, BRIEF_SCHEMA.md, and companion files.
Filesystem subtree under SOURCE_DIR, DRAWING_TYPE, and EXTRACTION_TARGET for per-page and assembled outputs.
Validation that an existing stub frontmatter matches the current run tuple before reuse.
Valid page outcome for pages with no matching extraction targets.
Valid P_AND_ID valve outcome for legend or reference sheets that reach dispatch.
Self-describing per-page artifact format carrying YAML frontmatter and findings table metadata.
Implemented drawing type with top equipment header extraction targets.
Implemented drawing type with valve count extraction targets.
Implemented drawing type with titleblock_index extraction target.
DRAWING_SET extraction target for titleblock inventory extraction.
PFD extraction target for basic top equipment header extraction.
PFD extraction target for detailed top equipment header extraction.
P_AND_ID extraction target for basic valve count extraction.
P_AND_ID extraction target for detailed valve count extraction with reconciliation support.
Operator-selected page scope file used to pre-filter P_AND_ID pages in production runs.
P_AND_ID valve tile grid, defaulting to 5x4 as the minimum production baseline.
Coarse location overlay whose worker locations are A1 through E5 instead of pixel coordinates.
Tunable crop geometry parameter for PFD header crop height.
Deterministic crop images used to improve extraction resolution, region discipline, and multiblock completeness.
Drawing region isolated by titleblock crops and optionally checked by title-block text extraction.
Deterministic QA report used as a skepticism gate and final coverage report.
Deterministic PFD QA step that may drop invalid rows, trim equipment names, or convert pages to NO_FINDINGS.
Detailed-target validation that blocks assembly on schema divergence across a page range.
Only supported PFD equipment merge key in v2 and duplicate-flagging key for PFD equipment outputs.
Visual language model used for visual-spatial interpretation of drawing content.
Core PFD header extraction difficulty involving visual association of tags, descriptors, and equipment blocks.
DRAWING_SET assembly output that operators may edit or pass as SCOPE_FILE for P_AND_ID valve runs.
Explicit basic counts CSV required when producing a basic-vs-detailed reconciliation report.
Optional flag that enables merging the new combined CSV against EXISTING_DATA_PATH.
